shots.focal_element: White Datadog dog mark and wordmark, then the centred two-line tagline
on_screen_text: Modern monitoring for a complex world
shots.typography: Wordmark in uppercase geometric sans; tagline in bold rounded humanist sans, sentence case, white, two centred lines with normal tracking and a soft drop shadow
shots.what_happens: Centred white logo sits over a purple-to-magenta gradient with drifting diagonal light bands; around 2.0 s the logo blurs out while a tilted plane passes, the tagline builds in ('Modern monitoring' first, then 'for a complex world' rising in) over a faint hexagon line pattern, and near the end translucent stylised hexagon host tiles slide in to hand off to the product UI.
shots.build_rebuild: On a diagonal purple-magenta gradient with animated translucent diagonal bars, show a centred white logo for ~2 s, blur-out it, then reveal a two-line bold white tagline line by line (second line slide-up with mask) over a low-opacity hexagon outline grid, and finish by sliding in two glassy hexagon cards containing tag chips.

shots.focal_element: A single red (high CPU) hexagon host tile with a highlighted outline in the Datadog host map, plus its host detail panel
shots.transition_other: stylised hexagon cards from the brand intro resolve into the real host-map hexagons (tinted glassy overlay fading into the UI); anchors label it other
shots.typography: Bold rounded humanist sans, sentence case, white, set on a parallelogram banner with a cut right corner and a purple-to-magenta gradient fill; appears only at the very end of the shot
shots.what_happens: Close-up of the host map hexagon grid: a red hexagon with tag chips (logs, log, whatever, host, agent, aws) is selected with a bold outline and a host detail panel (apps, agent, system, tags) shows beneath; the camera then pulls out fast to reveal thousands of tiny hexagons and the 'From 10,000+ hosts' banner snaps in over a full host-map view.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a hexagon-grid host map zoomed ~8x on one red selected tile with an outlined ring and a detail card below, then animate a fast scale-down pull-out (ease-in-out, ~0.6 s) to the full grid of thousands of small hexagons and pop in a gradient parallelogram label 'From 10,000+ hosts' at centre.

shots.focal_element: The full host map regrouping into availability-zone blocks, under the centred 'From 10,000+ hosts' banner
shots.typography: Same bold rounded sans on purple-to-magenta parallelogram banner, sentence case, white, held centred through the shot
shots.what_happens: The full-screen host map ('Your infrastructure') has 'availability-zone' chosen in the group-by dropdown; the hexagons scatter into a loose particle cloud and then re-settle into grouped blocks labelled us-east-1a 2.35k hosts, us-east-1b 2.01k and us-east-1c 1.85k plus many small clusters, while the banner stays fixed.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a static full-screen dashboard frame with a fixed centred gradient label, animate ~10k small hexagon sprites from one big grid to random scattered positions and then tween each into its group block layout (staggered position tweens, ~1.5 s total) with group headings fading in.

shots.focal_element: APM flame graph of the web-store ShoppingCartController#checkout trace with the 'to a single transaction' banner
shots.transition_other: new UI enters on a tilted perspective plane that swings flat (3D card swing); anchors label it other
shots.typography: Bold rounded humanist sans, lowercase sentence fragment, white, on a parallelogram banner with a magenta-to-purple gradient (direction reversed from the previous banner)
shots.what_happens: A trace flame graph with a 500 INTERNAL SERVER ERROR badge arrives tilted in perspective and settles flat; the view then pushes in on the rails.charge_payment span while a hover tooltip (payments-go, http.request POST /charge/) appears, with the error stack trace panel visible below; the banner continues the sentence started by 'From 10,000+ hosts'.
shots.build_rebuild: Swing a flame-graph screenshot in from a rotateX/rotateY tilt (~20 deg) to flat with ease-out, then scale-push ~1.3x toward a highlighted span and fade in a dark tooltip, keeping a centred gradient label 'to a single transaction' fixed on top.

shots.focal_element: Successive product views (network map, security signals, service map) each paired with a centred gradient caption banner
shots.transition_other: UI enters on a tilted perspective plane that swings flat; anchors label it other
shots.typography: Bold rounded humanist sans, sentence-case and lowercase fragments, white, on parallelogram banners with cut corners; banner gradients shift per caption (purple-to-teal, blue-to-teal, blue-to-teal-green)
shots.what_happens: Three sub-scenes inside one detected shot: (1) a network map of services with green and red circular nodes swings in tilted, then the camera pushes in on a red product-recommendation node while other nodes fade back and a metrics tooltip appears ('From millions of network flows'); (2) a Security Signals list swings in tilted, then the view pushes in to an 'Account Take Over (ATO) - Potential successful brute-force' signal detail panel ('and global security threats'); (3) a service map centred on a red web-store node, which then zooms toward the node as a purple ring and coloured edges grow ('to your most business-critical service'), with the banner sliding out right near the end.
shots.build_rebuild: Build three ~3 s beats that each swing a product screenshot in from a perspective tilt to flat, push the camera ~1.5x toward one highlighted element (dimming the rest to ~30% opacity or opening a detail card), and swap a centred gradient parallelogram caption per beat with a short slide; end with a fast push-in on the central node as the caption slides off screen right.
